name: temporal-tasks
description: Estimate substantive task budgets and reassess them against deterministic elapsed-time signals.

interface.shortDescription: Budget tasks and reassess elapsed work.
interface.longDescription: Temporal Tasks estimates substantive work with a five-factor difficulty score and uses privacy-preserving lifecycle hooks to surface elapsed-time and repeated-call reassessment signals.
defaultPrompt: Estimate this task's active-work budget and reassess when evidence or elapsed time invalidates the route.
